therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Plasma cell apoptosis and protein degradation disruption
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Previously untreated symptomatic multiple myeloma or light chain amyloidosis patients
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Maximum tolerated dose (Phase I) and response rates (Phase II)

results.effect_size: 35% CR/VGPR rate (95% CI: 22-50%) in Cohort A; 63% CR/VGPR/PR rate (95% CI: 45-79%) in Cohort B
results.target_engagement_evidence: Pharmacokinetic parameters measured including peak concentration, time to maximum concentration, and area under curve
subgroup_findings: Cohort B (light chain amyloidosis): 63% overall response rate
safety_signals: Grade 3+ adverse events in 36/48 patients (Cohort A) and 16/35 patients (Cohort B)
Cardiac events including atrial fibrillation, heart failure, cardiac arrest
Gastrointestinal events including diarrhea and gastric hemorrhage
results.dose_information: MTD: Ixazomib 4 mg weekly, Cyclophosphamide 400 mg/m² weekly, Dexamethasone 40 mg weekly

context.duration: Up to 48 weeks treatment, up to 5 years follow-up
